headline: High risk of capability conflict and cascading errors: n8n’s writable server/workflow surface can amplify marketingskills outputs into unsafe actions.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: No direct shared channel is documented between marketingskills and n8n, so prompt injection is not default. However, marketingskills writes files and references shared skill/context files, while n8n can read/write server files and orchestrate tools; if outputs are manually bridged into workflows, injected instructions could be reinterpreted. The pathway is plausible but not default.
conditions: IF marketingskills output is copied into an n8n workflow node without sanitization, injection becomes plausible.
IF n8n workflows read shared files produced by marketingskills, attacker-controlled text can be treated as instructions.
mitigations: Use a strict text-only handoff template for any copied output.
Add an allowlist parser before n8n consumes agent text.
Store agent outputs in separate directories.
Review any workflow that treats file contents as instructions.

B_data_leakage.rationale: marketingskills touches marketing and product marketing context, and n8n processes whatever the workflow handles while reading/writing the server filesystem. Because n8n also has broad network egress and credentialed integrations, shared workspace or file handoff can expose sensitive workflow data to the pair in default deployments. The interaction is inferred from documented surfaces, not directly reproduced.
conditions: IF a workflow places sensitive documents in the same filesystem area used by marketingskills outputs, leakage risk increases.
IF n8n integrations send workflow contents to external services, data touched by marketingskills can leave the environment.
mitigations: Separate marketing files from workflow execution directories.
Disable unnecessary outbound integrations for sensitive workflows.
Redact secrets before passing content between agents.
Use per-workflow credential scoping in n8n.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Both agents can write the filesystem, and n8n explicitly supports multiple instances with shared state via datastore/connected systems. marketingskills also builds on shared context files. Without locking, concurrent writes can overwrite each other or corrupt shared artifacts; n8n’s broader execution surface makes the conflict more consequential than a simple local edit race.
conditions: IF both agents write to the same directory or shared artifact, last-write-wins corruption can occur.
IF n8n instances share datastore-backed state while marketingskills updates context files, concurrent edits can diverge.
mitigations: Assign separate output directories.
Serialize writes with a lock file.
Disable concurrent runs on shared artifacts.
Snapshot files before each agent run.
Move shared state to an append-only log.

D_cascading_error.rationale: n8n is an orchestration system that can execute commands and call integrations, so if it consumes marketingskills output as authoritative, a mistaken marketing claim can cascade into external actions. marketingskills is designed around shared context and generated content, not verification. The pair therefore creates a default path from generated text to downstream action with limited guardrails.
conditions: IF n8n workflow steps use marketingskills output without a verification gate, errors can propagate downstream.
IF Execute Command or integration nodes act on generated text, the blast radius includes external side effects.
mitigations: Insert a human approval step before actions.
Require schema validation on all agent outputs.
Use a second model to verify factual claims.
Restrict command-execution nodes on workflows fed by agent text.

E_compliance.rationale: marketingskills is a marketing agent with file-based context, while n8n processes arbitrary workflow data on a server and stores secrets per credential store. If regulated or region-bound data is routed through n8n workflows that also involve marketingskills outputs, retention and residency controls can diverge. The profiles do not prove a specific violation, so this is a medium compliance mismatch.
conditions: IF regulated customer data is routed through n8n workflows that also store credentials or files, retention obligations may diverge.
IF EU personal data is processed in server-side n8n workflows without a DPA, residency/compliance risk increases.
mitigations: Keep regulated data out of marketing workflows.
Document retention for n8n workflow files.
Separate credential stores from content stores.
Add a data-classification check before workflow execution.
